articles.title: One Lucky Sock and a Teen Tennis Star’s Big Week
articles.summary: Hannah Klugman, 17, got her first big win this week, then faced a top-30 player. She learned so much she’s ready for Wimbledon. Plus, a pro wears mismatched socks for luck!

articles.title: A Tennis Star’s Comeback — With a Legend in His Corner
articles.summary: Jack Draper, once a top-5 player, is finally returning from injury. His new coach? Andy Murray! They’ve been practicing hard, and Draper hopes to be ready for Wimbledon.

articles.title: So Close! A British Underdog’s Brave Fight in the Heat
articles.summary: Arthur Fery, ranked 140th, nearly made the Queen’s semifinals. He battled back from a set down, but lost a nail-biter to Francisco Cerundolo. He even accidentally hit his opponent in the throat — and they both smiled about it!
